cause: iOS fixes render extent at 640x360. Surface resize updates the presenter profile while retaining that source extent. SurfacePresenter letterboxes to preserve its source aspect.
required_owner_work: Scene aspect/internal render extent must follow current oriented surface extent on the same process, window, lease and device generation, through an owning-runtime path.
inspection: Viewed both complete native simulator screenshots. Landscape has left/right borders; portrait has large top/bottom borders. Cooked content remains drawn but does not fill either current extent.
